title: Unexpected Harvest
next_chapter_hook: Chen Nian's true identity is far more complex than imagined—did she come searching for her brother, or does she harbor some secret mission unknown to all?

text.content: The night was as dark as ink, the bamboo grove at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain rustling in the evening breeze. Chen Ji crouched behind a massive boulder, his breathing barely audible, his gaze fixed intently on a secluded courtyard not far away. Ling Yuan's threatening words still echoed in his ears—next month's ritual... He calculated silently in his heart, his fingers unconsciously stroking the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his sleeve. Mo Xiansheng's residual soul within the pages trembled slightly, as if conveying some kind of warning. Chen Ji's brow furrowed—the Tianji Record showed that within the next three hours, Zhang Shen would come here alone.

dialogue.content: "Boy, be careful. That Zhang Shen has been frequently contacting the Holy Sect's secret envoys lately. What you witnessed was their scheduled exchange of intelligence." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, aged and weary. "However, this old man would like to see just how long you can maintain this waste of a persona."

text.content: A faint cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. He slowly rose from behind the boulder, brushed the dust from his robe, and strode toward the courtyard. Waste? He enjoyed that label. It was precisely because everyone thought him a废物 that a nobody like Zhang Shen would have no guard against him. The courtyard door was slightly ajar, and faint rummaging sounds came from within. Chen Ji took a deep breath and pushed the door open.

Zhang Shen had his back to the door, frantically retrieving several bamboo scrolls from a hidden compartment. At the sound, he spun around sharply. Upon seeing who it was, his expression underwent a spectacular transformation—first shock, then fury, and finally a sycophantic smile forced onto his face. "Chen... Chen Shidi? It's so late, why are you here?" Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze passed over Zhang Shen and landed on a token placed on the table.

dialogue.content: "Zhang Shixiong has refined taste, reading here in the dead of night?" Chen Ji's voice was flat, devoid of any波动. He stepped forward, his slender fingers picking up the token, playing with it nonchalantly. "This token is quite exquisite. I wonder which noble lord might have dropped it?"

text.content: The instant his fingertip touched the token's surface, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. That familiar pattern, the family crest engraved on the back—a half-blooming lotus with a tiny star embedded in its heart. He froze completely. He recognized this token. Twelve years ago, on the day his sister Chen Nian was taken away, such a token hung at her waist. It was the only memento their mother left her.

dialogue.content: "Th-this is something I found!" Beads of cold sweat broke out on Zhang Shen's forehead. He stepped forward, trying to snatch the token back. "If Chen Shidi likes it, just take it. There's no need to—" Before he could finish, a biting killing intent descended. Zhang Shen shuddered, staring incredulously at this "useless" shidi before him—that pair of eyes clearly concealed a bottomless coldness.

text.content: Chen Ji pocketed the token, his expression returning to calm. He stepped forward and patted Zhang Shen's shoulder, his voice floating lightly: "Zhang Shixiong, I have a question for you. Think carefully before you answer." Zhang Shen's body trembled slightly, yet he dared not dodge. Chen Ji spoke word by word: "Where is the owner of this token now?"

choice.prompt: Why did Chen Nian's token appear in Zhang Shen's possession? Has she already infiltrated the sect? Chen Ji needed to decide—should he interrogate the truth directly, or find another way to investigate.

choices.text: Forcing Zhang Shen to Reveal the Truth
choices.description: Threatening with his life to force Zhang Shen to explain the token's origin and the owner's whereabouts.
choices.risk_hint: If news leaks out, the sister will be in danger

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's fingers, like iron tongs, clamped around Zhang Shen's throat, pinning him against the wall. "I'll ask one more time." His voice was ice-cold, devoid of any emotion. "Who is the owner of this token?"

text.content: Zhang Shen's face turned bright red, his legs kicking frantically in the air. Gasping断续续地, he挤出 several words: "She... she's a newly recruited... maid of Elder Zhou... her name is... Xiao Nian..." The moment the words fell, Zhang Shen's eyes rolled back and he fainted. Chen Ji released his grip, letting him slide to the floor. Maid? Elder Zhou? His brow furrowed even deeper.

choices.description: Pocketing the token, pretending ignorance, slowly investigating the sister's true purpose through other channels.
choices.visible_reward: Avoid alerting the enemy, can see the full picture
choices.risk_hint: If the sister is in danger, may miss the opportunity

dialogue.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, a meaningful smile tugging at his lips. He bent down, propped the unconscious Zhang Shen onto a chair, and straightened his clothes neatly, as if nothing had happened. "Zhang Shixiong has had too much to drink. I'll take my leave now." He turned and left, the token in his sleeve burning hot.

text.content: Elder Zhou... Chen Ji silently念诵 this name. Elder Zhou was one of the few neutral factions within the sect, usually living seclusion and not close to Ling Yuan's faction. Why would his sister choose to hide there? To avoid attention, or does she have other schemes? Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the churning in his heart. Regardless, he had to see her in person, confirm whether she was safe.

The next morning, on the stone steps of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji, as usual, carried a broom, feigning a drowsy废物 appearance. His gaze, however, swept over every passing disciple without seeming to. Elder Zhou's residence was in the Listening Rain Pavilion on the western side of the sect, where mist constantly lingered, a good place for alchemy. A maid... what would she be doing there?

dialogue.content: "Little girl, that Heaven's Fate Lock Key identity of yours is no laughing matter." Mo Xiansheng's voice arose in his mind, carrying a hint of solemnity. "Her appearance here is by no means a coincidence. You'd better think clearly—is she here looking for you, or looking for something else?"

text.content: Chen Ji gave no answer. He raised his head, gazing toward the direction of Listening Rain Pavilion, a fleeting tenderness in his eyes that others could barely detect. Twelve years. He thought he had long forgotten his sister's appearance, but the moment that token fell into his palm, all the sealed memories surged back like a tide. Her twin buns, riding on his shoulders, giggling and wanting to pluck the stars—that image seemed like yesterday.

By evening, Chen Ji finally found his opportunity. Elder Zhou had gone out for an Elder Council meeting, leaving only a handful of servants in Listening Rain Pavilion. In his gray robe, hunched over, carrying a pot of hot tea, he blended in. Through the corridor, past the medicinal garden, Chen Ji's heart beat faster and faster. Finally, beneath an old plum tree in the backyard, he saw a familiar figure.

dialogue.content: The girl had her back to him, crouching on the ground, carefully watering a spirit mushroom. Her jet-black hair was tied in a simple bun, her coarse cloth clothes washed faded. Chen Ji's steps faltered, his throat微微滚动. He opened his mouth to call out, only to find he could not utter a single sound. Twelve years of separation, twelve years of searching—and now, so unexpectedly, reunited.

text.content: The girl seemed to sense something. She straightened up and turned her head. The moment their eyes met, Chen Ji saw a pair of eyes identical to his memory—clear, bright, but upon seeing him, a fleeting, indescribable complexity flickered across them. No joy, no rushing into his arms. She simply stood there quietly, her lips trembling slightly.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian saw Chen Ji but showed no joy at the long-awaited reunion. She seemed to be hiding something, or perhaps waiting for something. How should Chen Ji break this silence?

choices.description: Stepping forward boldly, calling out her name, expressing twelve years of longing and searching for her.
choices.visible_reward: May win back the sister's true heart
choices.risk_hint: If she has ulterior motives, she might take the opportunity to exploit this

dialogue.content: "Niannian..." These two words slipped from Chen Ji's lips, so soft they were barely audible. Twelve years of restraint, twelve years of pretense, nearly crumbled at this moment. He stepped forward, his voice slightly trembling. "Is that you? Is it really you?"

text.content: The girl's eye sockets reddened slightly, but she quickly lowered her eyelids, concealing all emotion. "The young master has mistaken someone." Her voice was as flat as stating the weather. "This servant is merely a maid of Elder Zhou's residence, not whoever the young master speaks of." Finished, she lowered her head and continued watering the spirit mushroom, as if the man trembling with excitement before her was nothing more than a negligible gust of wind.

choices.description: Suppressing the churning emotions within, pretending to be just a passing servant, secretly observing the sister's unusual behavior.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot confirm her true feelings for the time being
choices.risk_hint: If she is in danger, may miss the opportunity to protect her

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, the excitement on his face ebbing like a tide. He resumed his listless废物 demeanor once more, hunched over, coughing twice. "Aiyo, so sorry, so sorry, my old eyes are dim. Mistaken you for someone." His voice was hoarse and sycophantic. "Miss, you resemble my distant cousin from back home, that's why I lost composure for a moment."

text.content: He did not glance at the girl again, turning and slowly walking back. But in that instant of turning, he caught a glimpse—the girl's fingers tightly clutched her sleeve corner, her knuckles white. Chen Ji's heart sank. She clearly recognized him, yet why pretend otherwise? Twelve years apart—what had she experienced to become like this?

Chen Ji did not leave Listening Rain Pavilion. He hid behind a rockery, suppressed his breathing, his gaze tightly fixed on the figure beneath the old plum tree. The girl—no, Chen Nian—stood in place for a long time. Only after confirming no one was around did she hurry toward a side room deep in the backyard. A moment later, a faint glow appeared in that side room's window.

dialogue.content: "That room is set with an isolation formation." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly响起. "This old man can only sense a faint Heavenly Fate aura... the girl must have suffered much these years." Chen Ji clenched his fist, his nails deeply digging into his palm. He stared at that window with its faint light, and made a decision in his heart.

text.content: He could not recklessly reveal himself. Since his sister chose to infiltrate the sect under a hidden identity, she must have her reasons. If she was executing some dangerous task, his rash appearance would only alert the enemy and put her in danger. But he would never stand by and do nothing either. Chen Ji took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest, slowly infusing a thread of Heavenly Fate Value. A blurry image materialized in his mind—Chen Nian kneeling before an old man, and that old man's features... bore a resemblance to Ling Yuan.

The image was so blurred the details were almost invisible. Five points of Heavenly Fate Value consumed, yet only this fragmentary scene was exchanged. Chen Ji's brow locked tightly. The Tianji Record's predictions regarding Chen Nian had always been hazy—this was due to the nature of the Heaven's Fate Lock Key; her very existence interfered with the threads of fate. But one thing he saw clearly: Chen Nian was not imprisoned but kneeling there willingly. Her expression—was it respect, or... fear?

The night wind grew chillier. Chen Ji quietly withdrew from Listening Rain Pavilion. Walking through the corridor, his thoughts churned. The reason his sister didn't acknowledge him could be to protect him, or she herself was in some predicament and didn't want to implicate her family. Either way, he could not sit by and watch. Ling Yuan... that name evoked a wave of cold in Chen Ji's heart. If his sister truly had connections to that old fox, things would become far more complicated.

dialogue.content: "Niannian, whatever you are scheming..." Chen Ji raised his head, gazing at the night sky. The crescent moon hung like a hook, scattering a floor of cold silver light. He murmured softly, his voice scattered by the evening breeze, "Brother will protect you. This time, I will never let you be taken from my side again." The token in his sleeve was pressed against his chest, carrying a faint warmth. The twelve-year void—he would fill it with his own hands.

text.content: On the path of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji's silhouette faded into the distance. His pace remained slow, his back still hunched, his entire being radiating the withered气息 of a废物 servant. But if someone could see his eyes at this moment, they would discover that beneath that calm, water-like gaze, a flame capable of burning everything was kindling. Twelve years ago, the Holy Sect took his sister away. Twelve years later, she has finally returned. And he would let her know—that no one in this world could harm her again.

Inside the side room of Listening Rain Pavilion, Chen Nian sat alone by the window, the moonlight outlining her slender, pale silhouette. In her hand she held a token identical to Chen Ji's, her thumb gently stroking the lotus pattern on its surface. "Brother..." She silently念出 these two words, tears falling silently. "I'm sorry... I still cannot acknowledge you." She pressed the token to her lips, closing her eyes. In the night sky outside, a crow fluttered its wings and flew past, startling a shower of falling leaves. The chess game of fate had been laid out, and she—she was precisely that key piece yet to be revealed.
